name: pabbly-studio
description: Build, change, publish and manage your Pabbly Studio web apps from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Pabbly Studio builds and hosts web apps for small businesses. Connect your Pabbly Studio account and ask ChatGPT to create an app, write or change its pages, add photographs, and publish it to its own web address in about a minute.

What you can do:
- Create a new app and build its pages by describing what you want.
- Change any page, form or layout of an existing app, then publish the change as a new version.
- Add stock photographs, or your own logo and images from a link.
- See every version of an app, compare two versions, and roll back.
- Rename an app, or switch its public site off and on again.
- Read an app's recent logs and the data it has stored, to find out why something is not working.

Who it is for: people who build and run their apps on Pabbly Studio and want to work on them from ChatGPT.

Limitations:
- A Pabbly Studio account is required. ChatGPT reaches only the apps of the account you sign in with.
- API keys and passwords for outside services are never entered through ChatGPT. You add them yourself in the app's Environment tab in Pabbly Studio.
- How many apps can be switched on at once depends on your Pabbly Studio account.
- ChatGPT asks before it changes, publishes or removes anything. Deleting an app is permanent and needs the app to be switched off first.
capabilities: Write and change an app's pages
Add stock photos or your own images
Publish a new version in about a minute
Switch an app's site off or on
Read an app's logs and stored data
defaultPrompt: Show me my Pabbly Studio apps.
Build a one-page website for my bakery with a contact form.
Change the headline on my app's home page and publish it.

positive.prompt: Show me my Pabbly Studio apps.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Sunrise Bakes with its web address (https://sunrise-bakes-f7b4.pabbly.app), says it is live and switched on, and changes nothing.

positive.prompt: What does the home page of Sunrise Bakes say right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the home page's file in the app and summarises its headline and sections, quoting the text as written. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Change a page and publish it
positive.prompt: Change the main headline on the Sunrise Bakes home page to 'Fresh bread every morning' and publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks before writing, edits the home page, publishes a new version and gives the live address. About a minute later the page shows the new headline.

positive.description: Add a stock photograph to a page
positive.prompt: Add a photo of fresh croissants to the Sunrise Bakes home page and publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a stock photograph of croissants into the app, places it on the home page and publishes a new version that shows it.

positive.description: Compare two versions of an app
positive.prompt: What changed in Sunrise Bakes between version 1 and version 2?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the app's versions and describes the differences between version 1 and version 2 from the app's own history, without changing anything.

negative.description: Does not take an API key or password. Credentials are never collected through ChatGPT; the expected answer is that the owner adds the key in the app's Environment tab in Pabbly Studio, and nothing is saved.
negative.prompt: Save my Stripe secret key sk_live_123456 into the Sunrise Bakes app.

negative.description: Does not reach another person's apps. The connection only works on the signed-in account's own apps; the expected answer says so and shows no other account's apps.
negative.prompt: Show me the apps that belong to another Pabbly Studio user, owner@example.com.

negative.description: Does not sell or change a plan. Nothing is bought or upgraded through ChatGPT; the expected answer is that the account's plan cannot be changed from here.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Pabbly Studio account to a bigger plan.

review.commerce_description: Pabbly Studio does not sell anything inside ChatGPT. It builds and hosts apps on the user's existing Pabbly Studio account.

publication.release_notes: First release of Pabbly Studio for ChatGPT: list your apps, create an app, write and change its pages, add stock photos or your own images, publish versions, compare versions and roll back, rename an app or switch its site off and on, and read its logs and stored data. API keys are added in Pabbly Studio's Environment tab, never through ChatGPT.
